scope: One illustrative Gaussian sample; not a validation of every saved experiment or selected bandwidth.
nyquist_note: irfft uses only the real part of the even-grid Nyquist coefficient. The effective-amplitude frequency formula accounts for this exactly.
interpretation: Before clipping/renormalization, the inverse-FFT/spatial Gram and the properly weighted frequency Gram are algebraically equivalent by discrete Fourier orthogonality. The implemented corrections can break that equivalence.
